# Casefile v0.8.0

## Added

- Added `gpt-6.1-sol` to the Codex model catalog and implementation-writer profiles, with current
  model metadata, Casefile instructions, and all six effort levels from `low` through `ultra`.
- Added version-specific Claude profiles for `claude-opus-5`, `claude-fable-5-1`, `claude-opus-5-5`,
  and `claude-sonnet-5-5`. Each supports `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, and `max` effort for
  implementation writers, atomic reviewers, verification reviewers, and look-ahead investigators.

Existing Claude family aliases remain available. Version-specific profiles keep Opus 5 and Opus 5.5
independently selectable instead of relying on whichever version the `opus` alias resolves to.
Sonnet 5.5 requires Claude Code 2.1.284 or later; Opus 5.5 requires 2.1.280 or later.

Existing Codex installations receive the catalog changes through Casefile's model-catalog migration
after upgrading. Existing writer bindings and strategy defaults are preserved.
